title: 第11章 这个小姨到底是哪边的第12章 诡祟借命活马替死
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 苏月将信将疑地点了点头。
这“莫回头”
，她比洛璃了解得更深。
为了解决这个麻烦，上头特意派了一支镇妖司的精锐小队前来，按理说十天前就该到了，可直到现在依旧杳无音讯。
这也说明，那支小队恐怕已经凶多吉少。
这丫头……又是怎么平安走过来的？
不过，她紧接着又想到了另一件事，当即开口问道：
“小离，半个月前，我便花重金托人给你爷爷传信，让你推迟一个月再出发。
难道……你爷爷没有收到信吗？”
洛璃压下心中劫后余生的庆幸，疑惑地摇了摇头。
她爷爷这半年来身体一直不好，几乎是药不离身，她每天都寸步不离的守着，哪有什么送信的人来过？
苏月重重地叹息一声，眼中闪过一丝悲悯。
“看来，我派去的那位信使，十有八九是……凶多吉少了。”
提到爷爷，洛璃又想起了爷爷精心饲养三年的那匹宝马，俏脸一寒，刚想开口告状，苏月却先一脸歉意地先开了口。
“小璃，小姨暂且不能随你一同出发了。”
“原本此事我已经写在了信里，本以为你爷爷已经收到，可这‘莫回头’的出现，一下打乱了我们所有的安排。”
洛璃一愣，随后一脸疑惑道。
“不是说好了一起去大周的吗？怎么突然不能一同出发了？”
苏月叹了口气，缓缓道：“还不是因为这莫回头。”
“我们的皮货生意，因为这‘莫回头’挡道，这些日子一直在亏损，已经快要停摆。”
“就在刚才，我接到飞鸽传书，我苏家商会最重要的两位大客户，都折在了城外，命丧于‘莫回头’的手里。”
苏月疲惫地揉了揉眉心，脸上满是愁容。
“我必须留下来一段时间，想办法处理掉这个麻烦，再不济，也要想办法让我们的生意回到正轨，否则……”
洛璃闻言，把陈观卖掉她宝马的事也暂时丢在了一旁，脸上挂上了一抹焦急之色。
她们能在这偏远地界一直维持着优渥的生活，全都是依靠这妖魔皮货生意。
这是她们唯一的经济来源！
此次远赴大周，前路风云莫测，还不知要花多少银钱。
若是这唯一的财路断了，那她们日后在大周的日子，就算不说寸步难行，也必定是举步维艰。
可，爷爷刚刚病逝，原本以为小姨是她这一路的依靠，可这数千里险途，妖祟横行，人心叵测——
洛璃沉默了片刻，迂回道：“小姨，要不……我也在望月城等您一段时间？”

;;
Su Yue nodded doubtfully.
This "don't look back"
, she understands deeper than Luo Li.
In order to solve this trouble, the superiors specially sent an elite team from the Demon Suppression Division. It should have arrived ten days ago, but there is still no news until now.
This also shows that the team is probably in danger.
How did this girl... come here safely?
However, she then thought of another thing and asked immediately:
"Xiao Li, half a month ago, I spent a lot of money to send a message to your grandfather, asking you to postpone your departure for a month.
Could it be that...didn't your grandfather receive the letter? "
Luo Li suppressed the joy in her heart that she had survived the disaster and shook her head in confusion.
Her grandfather has been in poor health for the past six months and is almost always on medication. She keeps an eye on him every day. How can any messenger come?
"Alas!"
Su Yue sighed heavily, a trace of compassion flashed in her eyes.
"It seems that the messenger I sent is most likely... in danger."
Speaking of grandpa, Luo Li thought of the BMW that grandpa had carefully raised for three years. Her pretty face turned cold and she was about to complain, but Su Yue spoke first with an apologetic look.
"Xiaoli, my aunt can't go with you for the time being."
"Originally, I had written this matter in the letter, and I thought your grandfather had received it, but the appearance of 'Don't look back' disrupted all our arrangements."
Luo Li was stunned for a moment, and then said with a puzzled look.
"Didn't we agree to go to Dazhou together? Why suddenly we can't set off together?"
Su Yue sighed and said slowly: "It's not because of this that you shouldn't look back."
"Our leather goods business has been losing money these days because of the 'Don't Look Back' thing. It's about to come to a standstill."
"Just now, I received a message from Fei Ge. The two most important clients of my Su Family Chamber of Commerce were both found outside the city and lost their lives at the hands of 'Don't Look Back'."
Su Yue rubbed her brows tiredly, her face full of sadness.
"I have to stay for a while to find a way to deal with this trouble. Even if it doesn't work, I have to find a way to get our business back on track, otherwise..."
Hearing this, Luo Li temporarily put aside Chen Guan's sale of her BMW, with a look of anxiety on her face.
They can maintain a comfortable life in this remote area all because of this devil's leather goods business.
This is their only source of income!
This trip to Dazhou is unpredictable, and I don’t know how much money it will cost.
If this only way of making money is cut off, then their future life in Dazhou will definitely be difficult, if not impossible.
However, her grandfather had just passed away from illness, and she originally thought that her aunt would be her support along the way, but on this dangerous journey of thousands of miles, evil spirits were rampant, and people's hearts were unpredictable——
Luo Li was silent for a moment, then said in a roundabout way: "Auntie, how about...I'll wait for you in Wangyue City for a while?"
title_en: Chapter 11: Who is this aunt from? Chapter 12: The trick is to use life to live and die instead of a horse.
